title: henckelia serrata
intro: Henckelia serrata, commonly known as the 'Serrated Henckelia' or 'Serrated Lipstick Plant', is a type of flowering plant native to the Western Ghats of India. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and fever, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Henckelia serrata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Henckelia serrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
